answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must register identities by locking scarce resources like timber reserves into an escrow and executing cryptographic stake burning proportional to their peer-graph degree. When an identity cluster branches out like a nebula, quadratic staking penalties impose superlinear cost scaling O(N^2) on the attacker. Yielding a verified credential acts like a rare pearl, making forged multi-agent collusion mathematically cost-prohibitive.
